Unofficial integration, **not affiliated with Fluvius**. It reads your
digital meter in Flanders through your **Mijn Fluvius** customer account and
feeds its electricity consumption to the Gladys energy monitoring.

> **Never tested on a real Mijn Fluvius account.** It is built from the
> project [sander110419/Fluvius-home-assistant](https://github.com/sander110419/Fluvius-home-assistant)
> (whose author tested it live) and from sample answers. Please report what
> works and what does not on the Gladys forum.

## What you get

One device per meter you enter (electricity and/or gas).

Electricity:

- **Consumption (30 min)** or **Consumption (day)**: fed to the **energy
  monitoring** of Gladys, dated by Fluvius; the costs of your energy contract
  are computed on it.
- **Consumption, last published day (kWh)**: the total of the latest complete
  day Fluvius published, for a dashboard.
- **Injection, last published day (kWh)**: what you sent to the grid (solar
  panels) that day. **Shown only**: never counted as consumption nor billed.
- **Monthly peak, capacity tariff (kW)**: the highest quarter-hour average
  power of the latest month Fluvius published, the base of the Flemish
  capacity tariff.

Gas: only **Consumption, last published day (kWh)**. The gas stays **out of
the energy monitoring** in this version: Gladys would attach it to the main
electric meter and price it at the electricity tariff, as it has no gas
contracts yet.

Fluvius publishes the readings **after the fact**, usually the next day,
sometimes later, and corrects some. The integration reads Mijn Fluvius
**4 times a day**: once a day it reads again the last days (7 by default),
the other times the last 3 days. Gladys keeps one value per half hour (or per
day): a reading read again or corrected never counts twice.

## Before you start

- Gladys **5.2.0 or newer** (dated consumption of the energy monitoring),
  with its time zone set to **Europe/Brussels, Europe/Paris or
  Europe/Amsterdam** (the same clock as Belgium: the days of Fluvius then
  match the days of Gladys).
- A **personal** Mijn Fluvius account that signs in with an e-mail and a
  password. Professional accounts (itsme / eID) cannot be used.
- **Two-step verification**: the integration cannot type a code. If your
  sign-in asks for one (or for new terms, or a password change), the
  integration says so in its status: sign in once on
  [mijn.fluvius.be](https://mijn.fluvius.be/) in a browser, or turn the
  two-step verification off if Fluvius lets you.
- The **EAN** (18 digits, starts with 54) and the **serial number** of each
  meter (both required): they are shown in Mijn Fluvius and on your bills.
- For the detailed electricity readings: turn the **quarter-hour readings**
  on in Mijn Fluvius. Otherwise, choose the daily readings.

## Setup

1. Install the integration from the Gladys store.
2. Fill in the e-mail and the password of Mijn Fluvius, then the EAN and the
   serial number of your electricity meter and/or your gas meter.
3. Choose the electricity readings: **detailed** (quarter hours, sent by half
   hour) or **daily**. Choose before creating the device: the type of the
   consumption feature is fixed when the device is created (after a change,
   delete the device and create it again; until then the status says so and
   the device keeps its readings). The gas is always read by day.
4. Save, then press **Test the connection**: it signs in and shows
   yesterday's total of each meter.
5. In the **Discover** tab, create the devices. Their readings are read right
   away.
6. In the energy settings of Gladys, attach your energy contract to the
   electricity consumption.

## Privacy and security

- The password is kept by Gladys in its database (masked in the interface,
  **not encrypted**), never shown again, and only sent to Fluvius
  (`login.fluvius.be`): it is posted, in https, only to the sign-in server
  Mijn Fluvius names or to a `fluvius.be` address. The integration refuses
  any page or redirect that leaves Fluvius (or its Microsoft sign-in service,
  `b2clogin.com`).
- The access token stays in memory: after a restart of the integration, it
  signs in again (a reconnection to Gladys keeps it).
- Nothing is sent anywhere else. The logs never hold the e-mail, the
  password, the tokens or the addresses called.

## Limits

- The data comes from the customer portal, not from an official API: a
  change of Mijn Fluvius can break the integration until it is updated (the
  status then says "The Fluvius login changed"; tried again every 6 hours).
- One electricity meter and one gas meter per integration.
- The gas is not in the energy monitoring (see above).
- The injection and the monthly peak are shown, not used by the energy
  monitoring: Gladys has no dated production path for an integration yet.
- A half hour with one quarter hour missing is never published, unless
  Fluvius completes it within the days read again.
- If the integration (or Gladys) stays stopped longer than the "Days read
  again" setting, the days before that window are never filled in: raise the
  setting (up to 31) for a day after a long stop.
- A peak Gladys may compute from the 30-minute consumption is not the peak
  of the capacity tariff, which Fluvius measures over 15 minutes: use the
  "Monthly peak" sensor.
- Days and quarter hours follow the Brussels time (23- and 25-hour days
  included).

## Troubleshooting

- **"refused the e-mail or the password"**: check them in a browser on
  mijn.fluvius.be and save again. Tried again every 6 hours only, so that the
  account is never locked.
- **"asks for a step only a browser can do"**: sign in once on
  mijn.fluvius.be (code, terms, password change). Tried again every 6 hours.
- **"refused a fresh access token"** or **"The Fluvius login changed"**:
  Mijn Fluvius changed; tried again every 6 hours, an update of the
  integration may be needed.
- **"refused the readings of the … meter"**: check the EAN and the serial
  number, and that the account manages this meter.
- **"No detailed readings…"**: turn the quarter-hour readings on in Mijn
  Fluvius, or choose the daily readings.
- **"was created with … readings"**: the electricity readings setting
  changed after the device was created; delete the device and create it
  again to follow it.
- **"asked to slow down"**: nothing to do; every call waits for the time
  Fluvius asked (1 minute to 6 hours), even across a reconnection.
- **"could not be read… new try in N min"**: a passing problem (network,
  Fluvius down); tried again after 15, 30, 60, then every 120 minutes.

## Configuration settings

These are the settings Fluvius (Flanders) asks for in its configuration screen in Gladys.

| Setting | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Mijn Fluvius account (Flanders, Belgium) | `section` | No | Unofficial connector, not affiliated with Fluvius. It signs in to Mijn Fluvius with your e-mail and password, like the website, and reads your digital meter: the electricity consumption is sent to the Gladys energy monitoring (by half hour or by day, with the delay of Fluvius, usually a day or more), the injection of the last published day and the monthly peak of the capacity tariff are shown as sensors. The gas meter only shows the total of the last published day (it stays out of the energy monitoring until Gladys handles gas contracts). Personal accounts only (professional accounts need itsme/eID). Two-step verification cannot be handled: the integration says so if your login asks for it. |
| Mijn Fluvius e-mail | `string` | Yes |  |
| Mijn Fluvius password | `secret` | Yes | Kept by Gladys in its database (not encrypted), never shown again, only sent to Fluvius (login.fluvius.be). |
| Electricity EAN | `string` | No | The 18-digit code of the connection point (starts with 54), on your bills and in Mijn Fluvius. Empty: no electricity meter. |
| Electricity meter serial number | `string` | No | Required with the EAN. Shown in Mijn Fluvius with the meter and printed on it (e.g. 1SAG1100000000). |
| Gas EAN | `string` | No | Empty: no gas meter. The gas device only shows the total of the last published day: it stays out of the energy monitoring for now. |
| Gas meter serial number | `string` | No | Required with the EAN. Shown in Mijn Fluvius with the meter and printed on it. |
| Electricity readings | `select` | No | Detailed: quarter hours, sent by half hour; they must be turned on in Mijn Fluvius. Daily: one value per day. Chosen before creating the electricity device: changing it later needs the device deleted and created again. The gas is always read by day. |
| Days read again | `number` | No | Once a day, these last days are read again to catch the readings Fluvius publishes late or corrects (the other reads take the last 3 days). |

## How to install Fluvius (Flanders) in Gladys

1. In Gladys, open **Integrations**: Fluvius (Flanders) appears in the catalog, next to the native integrations, with a community badge.
2. Click **Install**. Gladys pulls the Docker image (`ghcr.io/lm1lc3n7/gladys-fluvius:0.1.1`), starts it in a sandbox isolated from the core, and generates the integration's interface (devices, discovery and configuration).
3. Open the **Configuration** screen of the integration, fill in the settings, and save.
4. You can also install it directly from its repository URL: [https://github.com/LM1LC3N7/gladys-fluvius](https://github.com/LM1LC3N7/gladys-fluvius).

Fluvius (Flanders) requires Gladys `>=5.2.0`. The catalog inside Gladys refreshes every hour, so a new version becomes available at most one hour after its release.

Not running Gladys yet? It is free and open source: [follow the installation guide](/docs/) to get started.

## About external integrations

Fluvius (Flanders) is an **external integration**: a community integration packaged as a Docker container and published on GitHub, that Gladys installs in one click and runs in a sandbox isolated from its core. It is published and maintained by [LM1LC3N7](https://github.com/LM1LC3N7), not by the Gladys core team.
